title: "Examples"

## Minimal tabs

```python
from anylumino import TabPanel, TextWidget

TabPanel(
    {
        "first": TextWidget("First child"),
        "second": TextWidget("Second child"),
    },
    titles={"first": "First", "second": "Second"},
)
```

## Add a tab after display

```python
tabs = TabPanel({"main": figure_a}, titles={"main": "Main"})
tabs

tabs.add("recent", figure_b, title="Recent", select=True)
```

## Figure dashboard skeleton

```python
from anylumino import CommandPalette, MenuBar, SplitPanel, TabPanel, Toolbar, VBox

actions = [
    {"id": "new-figure", "label": "New figure", "icon": "AddContent"},
    {"id": "refresh", "label": "Refresh", "icon": "RotateRight"},
]

callbacks = {
    "new-figure": lambda _id: tabs.add("figure-2", new_figure, title="Figure 2", select=True),
    "refresh": lambda _id: tabs.call_owner(tabs.selected_key, "refresh"),
}

toolbar = Toolbar(actions, callbacks=callbacks)
menu = MenuBar([{"label": "Figure", "items": actions}], callbacks=callbacks)
palette = CommandPalette(actions, callbacks=callbacks)

tabs = TabPanel({"figure-1": figure_panel})
controls = VBox({"menu": menu, "toolbar": toolbar, "palette": palette})

SplitPanel({"controls": controls, "workspace": tabs}, sizes=[0.25, 0.75])
```

Icons render through Spectrum workflow icons, the same convention used by
Spectrum-backed anylumino controls. Use `icon_src` for custom SVG/image icons and
`icon_size` for Spectrum icon sizing.

The frontend bundles are shipped with anylumino, so these examples do not
require CDN access for Lumino, Spectrum components, or bundled workflow icons.

## Local notebooks

The repository includes Jupytext notebooks for smoke testing:

- `notebooks/plotly_tabs.py` tests tabs and dynamic child addition with Plotly
  figures.
- `notebooks/plotly_dashboard.py` exercises all layout and action widgets with
  Plotly figure updates.
- `notebooks/input_controls_hbox.py` shows Spectrum-backed controls and native
  date/time controls inside `ScrollBox`.
- `notebooks/spectrum_components.py` focuses on Spectrum-backed controls,
  workflow icons, variants, and per-widget theme knobs.
- `notebooks/spectrum_remaining_components.py` demonstrates surface widgets,
  display helpers, dialogs, popovers, trays, tooltips, field groups, progress
  circles, color handles, and button variants.
- `notebooks/itables_tabs.py` places an `itables.widget.ITable` inside a tab,
  appends rows to a pandas DataFrame, and refreshes the displayed table with
  `ITable.update(...)`.
